title: Sculpted Face Ceramic Mug
description:
Each mug is shaped by hand, then finished with expressive facial details before glazing. Small differences in the eyes, lips and bow are evidence of the maker's hand rather than manufacturing defects.

The glazed ceramic body is designed for everyday display and use. Because the piece is handmade, colour, texture and exact dimensions can vary slightly between mugs.
alt: Cream ceramic mug sculpted with a face and pink bow

makerNote.quote: The expression changes slightly every time the clay passes through a different pair of hands.

title: Hand-Painted Ribbon Ceramic Mug Set
description:
The motifs are painted individually, so each mug belongs to the same visual family without being an exact duplicate. The set works for tea, coffee or a colourful shelf display.

The mugs are fired and glazed in Bát Tràng. Slight differences in brush pressure and placement are normal characteristics of the hand-painted finish.
alt: Set of hand-painted ceramic mugs decorated with ribbons and flowers

makerNote.quote: A set should feel connected, but every cup should still carry its own small character.

title: Brocade Blanket
description:
The blanket combines repeating geometric motifs with a substantial woven texture. It can be used as a throw, decorative layer or folded accent at the end of a bed.

Pattern alignment and colour intensity may vary slightly because of the woven construction. These variations make each finished textile distinctive.
alt: Stack of four folded traditional brocade blankets

makerNote.quote: The pattern becomes visible one crossing of thread at a time.

title: Handmade Brocade Horse Figurine
description:
The figurine uses small patterned textile sections to create a compact sculptural form. It is intended as a decorative object rather than a children's toy.

Because pattern placement depends on the section of cloth selected by the maker, every horse presents a different combination of colours and motifs.
alt: Colourful handmade horse figurine covered in traditional brocade patterns

makerNote.quote: Offcuts become useful again when they are joined into a new form.

title: Hand-Rolled Cinnamon Incense Bundle
description:
The incense is made for a warm, gently spiced atmosphere. Each bundle is tied for storage and can be separated into individual sticks as needed.

Natural ingredients can create small differences in colour, texture and burn time. Always use incense in a stable holder and in a ventilated space.
alt: Three bundles of hand-rolled cinnamon incense sticks

makerNote.quote: Drying slowly helps the sticks keep an even fragrance from beginning to end.

specifications.label: Safety
specifications.value: Burn only in a suitable holder

title: Natural Incense Cone Gift Set
description:
The cones provide a simple alternative to incense sticks and are packaged for storage between uses. Their natural brown surface reflects the ingredients rather than artificial colouring.

Place one cone on a heat-safe incense plate, keep it away from flammable materials and never leave it burning unattended.
alt: Natural brown incense cones in a metal gift tin

makerNote.quote: A small cone can hold the same careful preparation as a full incense stick.

title: Vietnamese Folk Painting — Child with Carp
description:
The child and carp motif communicates wishes for abundance, wellbeing and continuity. Strong outlines and flattened colour areas preserve the direct visual character of Vietnamese folk prints.

The work arrives framed for display. Minor variation in paper surface and printed colour is normal for craft-based production.
alt: Framed Vietnamese folk painting of a child holding a large carp

makerNote.quote: The image is simple enough to read immediately, but its symbols continue beyond the first look.

specifications.label: Care
specifications.value: Keep dry and out of direct sunlight

title: Vietnamese Mother and Child Painting
description:
The composition uses a quiet, intimate pose to centre care and family connection. Its compact scale makes it suitable for desks, shelves and small gallery arrangements.

The print is supplied in a simple frame. Keep it away from moisture and prolonged direct sunlight to preserve the paper and colour.
alt: Framed Vietnamese painting of a mother holding her child

makerNote.quote: Family scenes remain meaningful because they are understood without explanation.

title: Natural Stone Feng Shui Sculpture
description:
The sculpture emphasises the material's natural transitions, inclusions and uneven contours. It can be placed as a small focal object on a shelf, desk or display cabinet.

Stone patterning is never identical. The received piece may differ slightly from the photographed example while retaining the same overall product character.
alt: Polished natural stone feng shui sculpture

makerNote.quote: The stone already contains the main form; polishing helps the surface reveal it.

specifications.label: Care
specifications.value: Wipe with a soft dry cloth

title: Jade Lotus Mirror Sculpture
description:
The lotus form frames a reflective centre, creating a compact decorative object for a shelf or dressing area. The smooth stone finish contrasts with the reflective mirror surface.

Natural pattern variation is expected. Handle the mirror carefully and clean the stone and reflective surface with separate soft cloths.

makerNote.quote: The lotus gives the object a recognisable silhouette while the stone keeps every piece different.

specifications.label: Care
specifications.value: Clean with a soft non-abrasive cloth

title: Traditional Water Puppet — Royal Lady
description:
The figure translates a performance character into a display object while retaining the strong colours and simplified form associated with water puppetry.

This item is intended for decoration and cultural display. Painted surfaces should be kept dry and protected from impacts.
alt: Traditional Vietnamese water puppet depicting a royal lady

makerNote.quote: A puppet must be readable from a distance, so colour and gesture carry the character.

specifications.label: Care
specifications.value: Keep dry; dust with a soft cloth

title: Traditional Water Puppet — Drum Performer
description:
The figure captures a performance moment through a compact pose, bright paint and an immediately recognisable drum. It is designed as a display object referencing water puppet theatre.

Each puppet is painted by hand, so facial details and colour boundaries vary slightly between finished pieces.
alt: Traditional Vietnamese water puppet carrying a drum

makerNote.quote: The drum gives the figure rhythm even when the puppet is standing still.

title: Carved Wooden Longevity Deity Statue
description:
The sculpture uses an upright pose, flowing robe details and a calm expression to reference a familiar symbol of longevity and good wishes.

Wood grain and tone vary naturally. Small tool marks may remain visible and form part of the hand-carved finish.

makerNote.quote: A small figure still needs a clear silhouette and carefully balanced details.

specifications.label: Care
specifications.value: Keep dry; polish with a soft cloth

title: Hand-Carved Wooden Woman Sculpture
description:
The sculpture reduces the human figure to a calm seated silhouette, allowing the grain and carved transitions to carry much of the visual interest.

Natural knots, colour shifts and small surface differences are expected. These features ensure that no two sculptures look completely identical.
alt: Abstract hand-carved wooden sculpture of a seated woman

makerNote.quote: Removing detail can make the curve of the whole figure more important.

title: Carved Mother and Child Figurine
description:
The compact composition focuses on the shared outline of two figures, making the piece suitable as a family gift or a small symbolic display object.

The figure is carved and finished by hand. Grain direction and tone vary naturally across individual pieces.
alt: Carved figurine of a smiling mother embracing her child

makerNote.quote: The two figures should feel separate, but the outside shape should still read as one.

specifications.label: Care
specifications.value: Dust gently with a dry cloth

title: Bát Tràng Ceramic Vase with Hand-painted Lotus Motif
description:
Hand-thrown in Bát Tràng village and finished with a hand-painted lotus motif under a clear glaze. Each piece is fired individually, so subtle variations in glaze pooling are normal and part of its handmade character.

Care: wipe with a soft damp cloth; avoid abrasive scrubbing on the painted surface. Not dishwasher safe.

Returns: cracked or chipped on arrival is eligible for a full replacement within 7 days of delivery.

title: Hand-woven Silk Scarf in Natural Indigo Dye
description:
Woven on a traditional loom from mulberry silk and dyed with natural indigo. The tone deepens slightly with the first few washes as excess dye settles.

Care: hand wash cold, separately, and hang to dry in shade. Avoid direct sunlight for long periods to preserve the indigo tone.

Returns: unworn items with tags attached can be exchanged within 7 days.

title: Carved Rosewood Comb with Floral Detailing
description:
Carved from a single piece of rosewood and sanded smooth by hand, with floral detailing along the spine. The natural grain means no two combs look exactly alike.

Care: keep dry and away from prolonged heat; an occasional light coat of natural oil keeps the wood from drying out.

title: Bamboo Woven Lantern for Tabletop or Hanging Display
description:
Split and woven by hand from bamboo strips, finished with a light lacquer coat for durability. Suitable for LED candles or small string lights; not rated for open flame.

Care: dust with a dry cloth; avoid soaking in water.

title: Natural Agarwood Incense Coils, Box of 20
description:
Rolled by hand from natural agarwood powder with no synthetic fragrance added. Each coil burns for approximately 45 minutes with a light, woody scent.

Usage: place on a heatproof incense burner with the coil fully supported; keep away from drafts and flammable materials.

Quantity: 20 coils per box.

title: Đông Hồ Woodblock Print, Village Life Series
description:
Printed by hand from traditional carved woodblocks onto dó paper, using mineral and plant-based pigments in the Đông Hồ folk style. Framing not included.

Care: keep away from direct sunlight and humidity to preserve the pigment colors long-term.
